leftEvidence.title: God’s Spirit hovers over the waters

points.label: Scale of action
points.left: The Spirit hovers over the unformed creation.
points.right: The Spirit is named in one person’s account of being made alive.

points.label: Paired language
points.left: Spirit appears with waters and creation.
points.right: Spirit appears beside the Almighty’s breath and human life.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while keeping each speaker, Spirit referent, action, audience, and literary setting visible.

rightEvidence.title: Elihu names God’s Spirit as his maker and the Almighty’s breath as life

payload.tension: The first passage places God’s Spirit over the unformed waters; the second names Spirit and breath in one speaker’s account of being made alive.
payload.title: Spirit at creation and in human life
